title: arisarum vulgare subsp. simorrhinum
intro: Arisarum vulgare subsp. simorrhinum, commonly known as the arum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Arum. This plant is a type of perennial that produces greenish-yellow flowers and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Arisarum vulgare subsp. simorrhinum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, with bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenes contributing to its medicinal effects.
